eva: Heads-up — nightly-refresh job failed at 02:12 UTC (run=nightly-refresh-2026-03-17). 3 failing tests in tests/e2e/test_refresh.py::TestRefresh::test_checkpoint_apply. Looks like a kvcache timing/race. Logs linked by CI below.

ci-bot: CI: nightly-refresh #723 failed — 3 failing tests. logs: https://ci.internal/runs/723 (artifact: /artifacts/nightly-refresh/723/logs.tar.gz)

aj: On it. Can you paste the failing stack trace or tail of the log? If this is the kv cache race again we might correlate with the flush change last week.

eva: Pasting the tail (trimmed):
```
2026-03-17T02:12:07.843Z ERROR apply_checkpoint: kvcache flush timeout after 500ms
2026-03-17T02:12:07.844Z INFO retrying checkpoint apply (attempt=2)
2026-03-17T02:12:08.350Z ERROR test_checkpoint_apply FAILED - AssertionError: cache miss during apply
```
Repro locally with: `docker-compose up --build && pytest -q tests/e2e/test_refresh.py::TestRefresh::test_checkpoint_apply -k "kv" --maxfail=1`

simon: I saw a similar flake after commit 9d39f6a (kvcache flush tuning). Suggest bisect range 9d39f6a..main if rerun also fails. @infra-ops can you kick a rerun first?

infra-ops: Triggered rerun: nightly-refresh #724 (pinned to node gpu-3). /rerun request accepted, ETA ~10m. Will collect extra debug if it fails.

ci-bot: Rerun started — logs: https://ci.internal/runs/724 (live)

eva: Thanks. If #724 fails please capture full /proc, kernel dmesg, and keep the GPU pinned. Also add a quick smoke invocation in the job: `pytest tests/e2e/test_refresh.py::TestRefresh::test_checkpoint_apply -k "kv" -x --capture=no` to see stdout.

infra-ops: Noted. If rerun fails we'll start an automated bisect job across 9d39f6a..main and keep you posted. cc @aj @simon

ci-bot: Rerun #724 succeeded :white_check_mark: — 0 failing tests. Marked as flaky.

aj: Great — I'll open a tiny PR to add a flaky marker and a small jittered sleep around the kvcache flush in test to stabilize it. Assigning to me, will link the PR here. Thanks all for the quick turnaround!
